propositions: The primary Mirror Guard watcher (mirror-guard.yml) exits 1 on a single instantaneous sample of expected post-submit replication lag because run() lacks an evaluation window, while the module's design docstring delegates lag absorption to the alarm layer.
The secondary CloudWatch watcher (monitoring_ws7.tf) implements the designed sustained-divergence window (2x5-min) but the workflow never got one, leaving the CLI surface incomplete.
A fetch sequence that diverges then converges within ~15s (documented expected lag) currently exits 1 and reds scheduled runs; it should exit 0 once convergence is observed.

The fix adds an in-process, portable persistence wrapper (_replication_check_with_lag_tolerance) with configurable attempts/delay to re-sample on divergence and fail only when divergence persists across the window.
GitHub-ahead and foreign divergences never converge to the Gerrit SHA, so they remain failures across all samples; strictly no weakening of the failure set.
